definitions.explanation: A formal written document submitted when applying for admission to a school, taking an exam, or requesting something officially.

examples.japanese: {願書|がんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{願書|がんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I'm filling out a university application.

examples.japanese: {願書|がんしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金曜日|きんようび}→金曜日：00642_kinyoubi⟧です。
examples.english: The application deadline is next Friday.

notes:
USAGE:
{願書|がんしょ} most commonly refers to application forms for school entrance exams (⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧{願書|がんしょ}) or official requests. It implies a formal, written document rather than a casual request.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {願書|がんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to submit an application
- {願書|がんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to fill out an application
- {願書|がんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{寄|よ}せる→取り寄せる：26804_toriyoseru⟧: to send away for an application form
- ⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧{願書|がんしょ}: school admission application
- {願書|がんしょ}⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧: application reception
